name: Can I upgrade my kitchen cabinets without replacing my countertops?

mainEntity.name: Can I upgrade my kitchen cabinets without replacing my countertops?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is possible to upgrade your kitchen cabinets without replacing your countertops, especially if your countertops are in good condition and complement the new cabinet style. However, if you are planning a full cabinet replacement, it's often more efficient and cost-effective to consider replacing countertops simultaneously, as removing old cabinets can sometimes damage existing countertops. We can assess your current situation and advise on the best approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can upgrade cabinets without replacing countertops, but consider a simultaneous replacement for full projects.
